title: Names in rooms
changes: When you create or join a room you choose your name, and it is shown above the other person's messages
Names in a room must be different: if the name is already taken, you are asked to pick another one
"Change my name" in the room menu
The "Saved" popup now appears at the top of the chat, so it no longer covers the save buttons of the next files
New "Open the Linoa website" button in Settings
Small updates now get version numbers like v6.01 instead of a whole new version

title: Works on any network
changes: Your devices now connect even when they are on different networks, e.g. phone on mobile data and PC on home Wi-Fi
When a direct connection is not possible, messages and files go through an encrypted relay automatically (shown as "via relay")
The relay cannot read anything: everything is end-to-end encrypted with your room code
When a direct connection becomes possible again, the app switches back to it on its own

title: Rooms work like a group
changes: No more "Waiting for other device": you can use a room on its own, messages arrive whenever the other device is online
The room shows "online" or "offline" for the other device
The app now offers the new installer itself when there is one (for the Linoa name and icon on your desktop and home screen)

title: Hello, Linoa
changes: ChatRoom is now called Linoa, with a brand-new icon
Fixed the PC app repeatedly downloading the same update
Saved files now go to the Linoa folder in Downloads

title: Big redesign
changes: Completely redesigned, modern look on PC and phone
Delete any single message, photo, video or file for everyone, right from the message
Save photos, videos and files with one tap on the download icon
See when the other person is typing
See photos, videos and files coming in while they are still being sent, with progress
Removed "Clear chat for everyone" so your history can't be wiped by accident

title: Delete & auto-update
changes: Delete messages for everyone or just for you
Select several messages at once
The app updates itself automatically when opened

title: First release
changes: Chat between PC and phone over any network
Send text, photos, videos and files in full quality
Rooms joined with a code
Messages queue while the other device is offline
